notes: The published title uses 'gay' as an insult, so this page is titled Geoff Snider DS; the post's title is kept in the source citation as published.
No starting section was posted; Set Your Course For Alderaan (posted 'set your course for phil') and Prepared Defenses (posted 'prepared phil') are listed in the deck and count toward the 60.

The author replaced words in most card names with 'phil'; each row keeps the posted text. Dested from context: 'lord phil' = Lord Vader (the strategy says '2x lord vader'), 'phil's lightsaber' = Vader's Lightsaber (phil = Vader, as in 'lord phil'), 'maul's phil-saber' = Maul's Lightsaber (Tatooine), 'death star docking phil' = Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark), 'phil barrier' = Imperial Barrier, 'phil'lek advisor' = Twi'lek Advisor, 'phil levitation' = Weapon Levitation (the only Dark levitation interrupt of the era), 'projective phil' = Projective Telepathy, 'there'll be phil to pay' = There'll Be Hell To Pay, 'come here you big phil' = Come Here You Big Coward (a 2001 Effect).
'imperial phil x5' (in the interrupts) is printed as written: several Dark interrupts fit (Imperial Command, Imperial Reinforcements). Best guess Imperial Command, given the five admirals.

Posted 'battle plan' in a Dark deck dested Battle Order (Endor Effect), the Dark counterpart of Light's Battle Plan; 'oppressive/tint' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; 'iao' dested Imperial Arrest Order.
Generic systems use the Dark pages: Alderaan (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Endor (Dark).
